Amit —

Appreciate the SOW and the clear asks. High level: we can structure a 24-month prepay with an upfront discount and a quarterly true-up mechanism that protects you from major seasonal variance. Below is a concise proposal to start internal approval:

- Offer: 18% off list for a 24-month upfront prepay on committed usage (applies to baseline committed tokens).
- Ramp safeguard: Quarterly true-ups with a 20% corridor. If quarterly usage >120% of pro-rated commitment, additional usage billed at committed rate; if <80% at quarter-end, 50% of the shortfall can be carried forward to the next quarter; remaining shortfall refunded or credited at the end of year 2.
- Step-up option: After 12 months, GreenGrid may add incremental committed capacity at a pre-agreed escalator price (index-linked).
- True-up reporting: We’ll provide per-route token-level usage and cost exports for audit.

I’m copying Ben (pricing) to validate the 18% and the proposed carry/credit mechanics. If Ben signs off, I’ll send a clean offering and the pricing model workbook.

Best,
Rachel Kim
